name: Packaging and Logistics Automation Line
summary: A comprehensive logistics automation system integration solution covering the entire process of post-production packaging, conveying, and sorting.
contentHtml:
The packaging and logistics automation production line is a system integration solution provided by TXAM for post-production logistics.

Solution Composition

The system covers the entire process including automatic box opening, packing, sealing, labeling, sorting, conveying, palletizing, and warehouse docking.

Technical Advantages

  • Full-process automation, significantly improving logistics efficiency
  • High-speed sorting system with sorting accuracy of over 99.9%
  • Intelligent conveying scheduling for high equipment utilization
  • Seamless integration with WMS for transparent information
  • Modular design for flexible expansion
  • Integrated whole-line system for one-stop delivery

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, system integration, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: Packaging efficiency bottleneck
painPoints.desc: Manual packaging is slow, unable to meet the takt time requirements of high-speed production lines

painPoints.title: Insufficient sorting accuracy
painPoints.desc: High error rate in manual sorting, low logistics efficiency

painPoints.title: Conveying gaps
painPoints.desc: Poor conveying between production lines and warehouses, creating logistics bottlenecks

painPoints.title: Fragmented information systems
painPoints.desc: Packaging, conveying, and sorting systems operate independently with no information sharing

painPoints.title: Low space utilization
painPoints.desc: Traditional logistics layouts occupy large spaces, reducing warehouse efficiency

painPoints.title: Poor flexibility for expansion
painPoints.desc: Difficult to adapt to capacity changes and business expansion needs
